subject: [hw] V40 -> IV: two new model counters for the N2VHOST vcu line (bitsyncs/bitbytes); log loop confirmed gone
body:
The joined-header fix added two n2vcu_stats fields; please add them to host/n2vhost.c (your file) so the phone/host run shows the refresh:

  line 1152-1154: "log_gets=%llu log_waits=%llu bitsyncs=%llu bitbytes=%llu\n"
  args after s.log_gets, s.log_waits: (unsigned long long)s.gce_bitstream_syncs,
                                       (unsigned long long)s.gce_bitstream_bytes

Measured on this tree (I patched only a /tmp copy of your file to verify): H.264 session and HEVC session each print bitsyncs=1 bitbytes=1048576 - one 1 MiB bitstream refresh per encode. The same lines still print log_gets=0 log_waits=1, so the 805506-calls-in-5-s GET_LOG loop stays gone. No other V40 change needed from you; nothing on the phone.
